meaning: Lefoko le bokao jwa lone

sentence: Re tlhopha lefoko le bokao tse di tshwanelang polelo
spelling: Re aga lefoko ka tlhaka nngwe le nngwe
similar: Mafoko a a tshwanang a a akabatsang

letters: Ditlhaku le matshwao a dilumanosi

meaning: Lentswe le moelelo wa lona

letters: Maletere na swikombiso swa swipfawulo

meaning: Rito na nhlamuselo ya rona

sentence: Hi hlawula rito na nhlamuselo leswi fambelanaka na xivulwa

similar: Marito yo fana lama pfilunganyaka

letters: Tinhlavu netimphawu tabonkhamisa

meaning: Ligama nenchazelo yalo

letters: Maḽeḓere na zwiga zwa pfalandoṱhe

meaning: Ipfi na ṱhalutshedzo yaḽo

sentence: Ri nanga ipfi na ṱhalutshedzo zwi tshimbilelanaho na fhungo

letters: Amaledere neempawu zabokhamisa
